marketMood: Risk-off in chip hardware: Samsung's record 1,800% profit surge triggered a sell-the-news rout across semiconductors, DeepSeek's proprietary chip ambitions spooked AI infrastructure bulls, while an LNG tanker attack near Hormuz pushed oil 3% higher and lifted bond yields — today's FOMC minutes add another catalyst to watch.

topStories.headline: Samsung's 1,800% Profit Surge Triggers 'Sell the News' Global Chip Rout
topStories.summary: Samsung Electronics reported Q2 2026 preliminary operating profit of 89.4 trillion won ($58.4B), up ~1,800% YoY — the highest quarterly profit ever for any tech company — but shares sank ~7% as investors booked profits and questioned whether AI hardware spending can sustain the pace.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ Semiconductor index fell 4.5%+; Intel and Applied Materials ↓10%, AMD ↓8%, Micron ↓4.7%, Broadcom and Marvell lower; Nasdaq ↓1.16%; S&P 500 ↓0.45%

topStories.headline: DeepSeek Developing Its Own AI Inference Chip, Reducing Reliance on Nvidia and Huawei
topStories.summary: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek is in the early stages of designing a proprietary inference chip, reaching out to foundry and memory partners — a project quietly underway for about a year that could reduce its dependence on Nvidia and Huawei silicon.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ Nvidia faces shrinking China AI revenue; Huawei's domestic AI chip market share at risk; reinforces global chip sector selloff

topStories.headline: FOMC June Meeting Minutes Released Today; Markets Await Warsh's Debut Tone
topStories.summary: The Federal Reserve releases today the minutes from Chair Kevin Warsh's first FOMC meeting, with markets focused on the vote breakdown, language on inflation (May CPI at 4.2% YoY), and any signals on whether rate hikes are back on the table.
topStories.marketImpact: Hawkish tone → ↓ SPY, TLT; Dovish surprise → ↑ bonds; September hike odds at ~58% given oil-driven inflation concerns; Fed funds currently at 3.50–3.75%

topStories.headline: Amazon Launches $25 Billion Bond Sale to Fund AI Infrastructure Build
topStories.summary: Amazon is raising at least $25 billion in a multi-tranche bond deal spanning 3 to 40 years to fund AI capital expenditures, with peak investor demand hitting $62 billion — and the company confirmed it will not issue additional debt for the remainder of 2026.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ Signals sustained hyperscaler AI capex commitment; watch data center suppliers; ↓ bond market faces near-term supply pressure alongside Hormuz-driven yield rise

topStories.headline: Rivian Stock Falls 18% on 75 Million Share Offering to Fund Georgia Factory
topStories.summary: Rivian launched an underwritten public offering of 75 million Class A shares to raise ~$1.5 billion for its Georgia manufacturing buildout under the DOE loan programme, just days after posting stronger-than-expected Q2 delivery numbers.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ RIVN sharply diluted; signals continued cash burn in EV sector ahead of R2 production ramp

topStories.headline: LNG Tanker Struck Near Strait of Hormuz, Brent Crude Jumps 3%
topStories.summary: An LNG carrier was hit by an unidentified projectile while transiting near the Strait of Hormuz, raising fresh energy security fears in a region still fragile following the February 2026 US-Israel-Iran conflict and June ceasefire agreement.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ Brent crude settled at $74.16/bbl (+3%); WTI at $70.44 (+2.8%); ↑ US 10Y yield rose to 4.50%; ↑ 30Y yield broke above 5% on reinflation fears; ↑ watch XOM, CVX

topStories.headline: US Trade Deficit Widens to $77.6 Billion in May, Highest in Over a Year
topStories.summary: The US goods and services trade deficit surged from $54.6 billion in April to $77.6 billion in May on broad import gains and declining exports — the widest gap in more than a year, expected to weigh on Q2 GDP estimates.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ Expected to drag Q2 GDP; watch July 24 Section 122 tariff expiry for trade policy direction; ↑ dollar uncertainty

topStories.headline: Nikkei 225 Falls 2.12% to Three-Week Low as Japan Chip Names Collapse
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 tumbled 2.12% to 68,257 as the global semiconductor rout savaged domestically-listed chip equipment and component makers — Kioxia fell 11.3%, Taiyo Yuden 11%, Murata 10.1%, and Lasertec 6.4%; the Topix fell 0.97% to 4,062.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ Japan chip sector broadly crushed; ↑ Mitsubishi UFJ +2.3% and Fast Retailing +1.1% as investors rotated into financials and defensives

topStories.headline: Hang Seng Rises 1.3%; Kuaishou Surges 8% on Kling AI's $2.8 Billion Funding Round
topStories.summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng gained 1.3% to ~23,350 as domestic internet and AI-play stocks rallied, with Kuaishou jumping 8% after its Kling AI unit closed a $2.8 billion round backed by Alibaba, Tencent, and Baidu at a $15 billion valuation.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ HSI outperforms global tech on China AI software narrative; Kling AI targets a Hong Kong IPO as early as mid-2027; 1024.HK, 0700.HK, 9988.HK all higher
